name: How long does ceiling molding installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does ceiling molding installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of ceiling molding installation depends on the project's scope, including the total lineal footage of molding, the complexity of the room shapes, and the type of molding chosen. A typical residential room might take one to two days for installation and finishing. Larger projects or those with intricate cuts, such as multiple corners or curved walls, will naturally require more time. Before starting, we will provide a detailed project timeline based on the specific details of your home in areas like Meridian or Eagle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies based on project size and complexity, usually 1-2 days per room. Larger or more intricate projects will take longer to complete.
